name: base-blocked-unlock-pickup
task: Pick up the blocking ball and the key, in either order, unlock the door, and then pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The hard Existence(door_open) clause is redundant. Door opening is already forced by the hard Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) together with the hard Existence(target_picked_up), so the Existence(door_open) clause adds no new requirement and repeats what the other clauses guarantee. Remove the Existence(door_open) clause.

texts: The blocking ball must be picked up at least once.
The matching key must be picked up at least once.
The blocking ball must be moved before the door is opened.
The key must be acquired before the door is opened.
The door must be opened before the target box is picked up.
The target box must be picked up at least once.
